blocks.text: Homes for Sale on the King George Corridor, South Surrey

parts.t: King George Corridor is the MLS® sub-area along King George Boulevard in South Surrey, with townhomes, condos and detached homes close to Highway 99. Explore active listings below, and contact Jared with questions about the area.

King George Corridor is the strip of South Surrey that follows King George Boulevard from 8 Avenue north to the Nicomekl River, with Highway 99 along its east side. The City of Surrey uses the same name for this plan area. Its old corridor plan has been replaced by the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan. You'll find a mix of detached homes, townhouses and some duplex and fourplex-style homes. Planned bus rapid transit along King George Boulevard is the big change to watch.
Local Guide · King George Boulevard & Semiahmoo

blocks.text: Getting to know King George Corridor

parts.t: and Surrey City Centre, you've driven the corridor. It is long and narrow, centred on King George Boulevard, and it links the Semiahmoo Town Centre area at the south end to the Nicomekl River crossing at the north end.

blocks.text: Boundaries 8 Ave to Nicomekl River · West of Hwy 99

parts.t: The City describes the plan area as running along King George Boulevard from 8 Avenue to the Nicomekl River, with Highway 99 to the east, the river to the north and 8 Avenue to the south. The City page does not state a west boundary road.

blocks.text: Plans: what applies today OCP & Semiahmoo Town Centre Plan

parts.t: Land-use designations for this area now come from the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan. The older King George Corridor concept plan is useful background, but its designations have been superseded, so don't rely on it for what can be built today. At the south end, the Semiahmoo Town Centre Plan covers the area between 16 Avenue and 24 Avenue.

blocks.text: Transit, now and next King George Boulevard Bus Rapid Transit

parts.t: Today, route 321 runs along King George Boulevard between Surrey Central Station, Newton Exchange and White Rock Centre. Route 345 runs between King George Station and White Rock Centre.

Next, the City and TransLink are planning King George Boulevard Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) from Surrey City Centre to Semiahmoo Town Centre, with dedicated bus lanes along most of the route. Council has moved the project to full design.

blocks.text: Schools Earl Marriott, Semiahmoo & Elgin Park

parts.t: Earl Marriott Secondary, at 15751 16 Avenue, sits at the south end near the Semiahmoo Town Centre. The corridor crosses several catchments on the Surrey Schools boundary map. From south to north, elementary schools are White Rock and Peace Arch at the south end, H.T. Thrift (west) and Jessie Lee (east) in the south-middle, Semiahmoo Trail in the north-middle, and Chantrell Creek at the north end. For secondary, the south part is Semiahmoo Secondary on the west side and Earl Marriott on the east, and the north part from about 24 Avenue to the Nicomekl River is Elgin Park Secondary.

blocks.text: Parks, recreation and libraries South Surrey Rec, Aquatic Centre & Libraries

parts.t: Nearby City facilities include the South Surrey Recreation & Arts Centre (14601 20 Avenue), the Grandview Heights Aquatic Centre (16855 24 Avenue), and the Semiahmoo (1815 152 Street) and Ocean Park (12854 17 Avenue) libraries.

blocks.text: Shopping Morgan Crossing, Semiahmoo & Grandview Corners

parts.t: Morgan Crossing, at 15715–15670 Croydon Drive, is east of the corridor near 24 Avenue. Semiahmoo Shopping Centre on 152 Street is close to the south end. To the east,
at 24 Avenue and 160 Street has more stores.

blocks.text: Housing types Houses, townhomes, duplexes & low-rise condos

parts.t: An older City study describes detached single-family homes in parts of the corridor, townhouses on the east side south of 16 Avenue, and low-density duplex and fourplex homes fronting the boulevard north of the commercial node at 160 Street. For townhomes along the corridor, see my

blocks.text: Zoning and added units 3 to 6 units · Frequent Bus Stop Areas

parts.t: Every Surrey property has a zone under Surrey Zoning Bylaw 12000, shown in the City's COSMOS map. Surrey's small-scale multi-unit housing zones are RA, R1, R2, R2-O, R3, R4, R5, R5-S and R6. Lots under 280 m² can usually have up to 3 units and larger lots up to 4. Eligible lots within 400 m of a frequent bus stop can have up to 6. One secondary suite is allowed per dwelling unit, subject to zoning, a building permit and the BC Building Code. Homes along a busy bus corridor may fall inside a Frequent Bus Stop Area, so check COSMOS. My
explains the zone names in plain terms.

blocks.text: Floodplain at the north end & Market Info Coastal floodplain & FVREB stats

parts.t: The north end of the corridor meets the Nicomekl River. Surrey's coastal floodplain runs along the Nicomekl and Serpentine Rivers, and the Nicomekl is controlled by a sea dam just off Elgin Road.

Is King George Corridor an official City name?
Yes. The City of Surrey uses King George Corridor for this South Surrey plan area, and it matches the Paragon sub-area name.
Which plan sets land use here now?
The Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan. The older corridor plan's designations have been superseded.
What buses run the length of the corridor?
Route 321 runs Surrey Central, Newton and White Rock Centre via King George Boulevard. Route 345 runs between King George Station and White Rock Centre.
What is planned for transit on King George Boulevard?
King George Boulevard BRT, planned by the City and TransLink from Surrey City Centre to Semiahmoo Town Centre, with dedicated bus lanes along most of the route.
Can a house lot here add units?
Many single-family and duplex lots can have 3 to 4 units depending on lot size, and up to 6 within 400 m of a frequent bus stop. Check the zone in COSMOS.
Is the north end in a floodplain?
The corridor's north edge is the Nicomekl River, and Surrey's coastal floodplain runs along it. Check the City's floodplain pages for the specific lot.
Where's the nearest big shopping centre?
Morgan Crossing, a mixed-use development east of the corridor near 24 Avenue.
